input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable. The termination of selected Service Option Attachments will not affect Customer's obligation to pay charges under other Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: This is a hosting/services agreement in which IBM holds our Content, so the playbook expects an exit clause. Section 3.5 (Effect of Termination) addresses only accrued payment obligations, and no transition, exit, data return/export or deletion language exists anywhere in the document (searches for transition, return, export, delete/destroy and migration returned nothing; §§ 11.6 and 14.18 address Customer responsibility for Content and contact-data processing only, and § 14.2 merely lists 3.5 as surviving). The Agreement therefore fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export) and leaves us exposed to loss of Content on termination. We inserted the preferred model language into § 3.5 — six months' transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, 30-day return in machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter — with the 90-day fallback flagged in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, Content return and certified deletion obligations in § 3.5
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement currently addresses only accrued payment obligations on termination, with no right to transition assistance or return of our Content. We have added our standard exit provision: up to six months' transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. We can work with 90 days of transition assistance if six months is an issue.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Content and other Customer data in its possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and Customer data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
